question: In the 2021 Winter Session of the Parliament, how many bills were passed in both the Houses of parliament in total from the 13 bills that were tabled?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Winter Session, 2021 of Parliament:-**

__
 
• 18 sittings spread over a period of** 24 days during the Session.**
 
• **11 Bills passed **__by both the Houses of Parliament;** 13 Bills- 12 in Lok Sabha and 1 in Rajya Sabha Introduced.**
 
• The** productivity **of the Lok Sabha was **approximately 82% **and that of the Rajya Sabha was **approximately 48%.**
 
• Three Bills replacing Ordinances considered and passed by the Houses
 
• **Biological Diversity (Amendment) Bill, 2021** referred to Joint Committee of both Houses of Parliament; Five Bills being Referred to Standing Committees

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** **Sessions of Parliament:**

__
 
• The Government convenes the session of parliament in India. India does not have a** fixed parliamentary calendar.**__
 
• By convention (i.e. not provided by the Constitution), Parliament meets for **three sessions in a year.**
 
• The President** summons each House of Parliament from time to time.**
 
• The gap between the two sessions of the Parliament __**cannot exceed 6 months, **__which means the Parliament meets at least two times in one year.
 
• A session of the Indian Parliament is the period during which a House meets** almost every day uninterruptedly **to manage the business. There are typically three sessions in a year. A session contains many meetings.
 
• The process of calling all members of the Parliament to meet is called the Summoning of Parliament. It is the President who summons Parliament.
 
• **In general, the sessions are as follows:**
 
 
• **Budget session (February to May)**
 
• **Monsoon session (July to September)**
 
• **Winter session (November to December)**
